name: Liar
description: A nice little laser cannon, the Liar is good for brief combat, or against ships with little or no shields.  If this is all you have, don't take on armies.

name: Bender
description: Cromforge Enterprises' introductory laser, the Bender is one of the most widely used weapons in the 5 systems.  Although a couple of Benders won't get you that far, it can ward off a close range attacker until you fly to safety.

name: Warper
description: The Warper is closely related to the Bender.  With a faster fire rate and lower energy use, it will provide experienced pilots with a bit more protection when flying cargo or defense missions.  The penalty of course is size.

name: Illuminator
description: While more powerful than a flashlight, the Illuminator is not considered an especially powerful weapon.  It is more powerful than other conventional light lasers, and any edge in combat is a good thing.

name: Dealer
description: T&P's upgrade to the Liar, the Dealer packs a bigger punch and can slice shields and melt through most armor in a reasonable amount of time.

name: Needle
description: The Needle provides a pilot with serious fire power.  Make sure you have a decent amount of energy flow, since this little baby will drain you fast.

name: Calefactor
description: The tradeoff is simple... a bit more power takes a bit more power.  For the more intermediate pilot, the Calefactor is a good way to learn how to balance fire power with accuracy.

name: Thorn
description: A ship armed with two Thorns and a good power supply is nothing to toy with.  One thing is certain, you don't want this Thorn in your side.

name: Straker
description: Think of the Straker as a basic machine gun.  Although each projectile does relatively little damage, they can be fired with amazing succession without much drain on energy systems.  Make sure you get in nice and close before pulling the trigger.

name: Landlord
description: When it comes to distance combat against enemy defenses, the Landlord can really collect.  It is vital to have percussive power in deep space combat and this item won't cost too much in credits or energy.

name: Peeler
description: T&P's updated long range mortar.  The enemy will hardly know where the shots are coming from.  Remember T&P's motto for this gun: 'If You Can't Dealer, Peeler.'

name: Rasp
description: The Rasp is a powerful but slow mortar weapon which can be fired over long distances with some degree of accuracy.  It is best used for considerable damage from long range, then move in for the kill.

name: Senator
description: Annihilitech's pride and joy, a ship with two Senators is nothing to negotiate with.  The concussion caused by this mortar weapon will blow your foe to pieces in a few hits.  One major disadvantage is the slow refire, but if you land two or three rounds, that won't be a problem.

name: Serializer
description: There's nothing more satisfying than some warm plasma at your side, kind of like a snuggly teddy bear.  Only this isn't a bear your enemies will want to hug.  The Serializer is the premier weapon, proudly brought to you by the best and brightest at PSI.

name: Broker
description: Ship based mining lasers are a technology that provides the economic backbone for much of the Quantar spacefaring community.  A mining beam combines a pulsed excimer laser to remove small chunks of asteroids, along with a tractor beam collection system.  The Broker is the early, bulky version, but it is affordable.

name: V.A.P.O.R.
description: No one knows how the technology really works, but rumor has it that Samsun has discovered a new photoactive mineral somewhere in Hyperial space.

name: Injustice
description: Although more powerful than the Calefactor, the Injustice carries with it a massive drain on energy. That being said, if energy is not a major concern this laser can do incredible amounts of damage.

name: Shark
description: The third addition in the T&P line of lasers, the Shark is more powerful than the Dealer, with a quicker cycle rate.  If you need a little extra speed and firepower, it may be worth it.

name: Cobra
description: Not only one of the fastest projectile weapons in the known systems, the Cobra also fires two rounds at once.  An experienced pilot with a Cobra can tear through any intervening armor in no time.

name: Thief
description: The Thief is a devastating gravity displacement weapon.  Aristio is the first company to turn the gravity instability found in jumpgates into a lethal weapon.  Although the Thief is the first of its kind, manufacturers will be sure to take this technology to new heights and uses.

name: Hammer
description: The Hammer is a medium speed, medium damage, medium cycle rate projectile gun.  Used well it will get your enemies medium dead.

name: Barrak
description: A gauss cannon from Dorator, the Barrak is a good balance between damage, energy use and rate of fire.  Get a couple and try them out. You will not be disappointed.

name: FeatherFire
description: When every shot counts and damage is everything, the FeatherFire is the weapon of choice.  It recharges slowly and takes massive amounts of energy, but also inflicts incredible amounts of damage, and has a range advantage over conventional lasers.

name: Hitman
description: The long awaited Hitman was for a long time the subject of great debate.  Many weapon manufacturers including T&P systems maintained that it was an impossible piece of technology; but once again Aristio has lived up to the challenge.

name: Nova Mk.I
description: Consuming a huge amount of energy, the Nova also deals out a huge amount of punishment.  Word to the wise; dont miss with this weapon, because you won't be able to fire again for a while, but with a direct hit not much more will be needed.

name: Banker
description: The Banker is an upgrade to the prototypical Broker.  Venurian Prospecting has demonstrated that their technology is quite effective and this new mining laser is almost twice as powerful as the Broker.

name: Excavator
description: T&P's first feeble attempt at a mining laser.  It is usable and cheap, but not nearly as fast or efficient as Venurian Prospecting's base model.

name: Duster
description: OPL's mining laser is a viable weapon, but only at insanely close range.  As a mining system it is exceeded by every other unit available in its class.

name: S-W-28
description: The S-W-28 is Solrain's stock equipment laser, and is basically a modified Liar.  All Solrain pilots are given this as part of their starter package.  TRI subsidizes production of this model, and therefore it cannot be legally traded or sold for much value.

name: Cracker
description: The Cracker is Quantar's stock equipment mining laser, and is a modified Broker for cheap production purposes.  All Quantar pilots are given this as part of their starter package.  TRI subsidizes production of this model, and therefore it cannot be legally traded or sold for much value.

name: LightFire
description: The LightFire is Octavius's stock equipment laser, and in a nutshell is a modified Illuminator.  All Octavius pilots are given this as part of their starter package.  TRI subsidizes production of this model, and therefore it cannot be legally traded or sold for much value.

name: Deceptor
description: In response to demands for a longer ranged light weapon, T&P created a new class of weapon.  While still considered a small laser, the Deceptor has an extended life, giving it greater reach than standard light lasers.

name: Distorter
description: Using more or less the same techniques to improve the coherence length of the phased array solid state lasers as its competitors, Cromforge none the less produced a slightly more efficent and rapid firing model.

name: Lastlight
description: Predicted to often be the last thing a Conflux sees, the Lastlight's extended range and fairly low power requirements make it a great complement to medium lasers, or as a stand alone weapon for smaller ships with limited available power.

name: InSight
description: This gun is not really a weapon at all, rather it is a specialized targeting device that generates a beam of multiple wavelengths used in the investigation of wreckage.  When coupled with a matter displacer, it can be used to recover valuable artifacts.

name: Financier
description: With the advent of the Light Miner class of spacecraft, a new mining laser named the 'Financier' has been developed. The laser will fully take advantage the mining ship's large gun hardpoints.

name: RB-1
description: Repair beam technology utilizes special capabilities of some component artifacts in order to materialize and repair a ship's armor.

name: RB-2
description: Repair beam technology utilizes special capabilities of some component artifacts in order to materialize and repair a ship's armor.

name: RB-3
description: Repair beam technology utilizes special capabilities of some component artifacts in order to materialize and repair a ship's armor.

name: RB-4
description: Repair beam technology utilizes special capabilities of some component artifacts in order to materialize and repair a ship's armor.

name: Vantage
description: In making this improved heavy mortar, Tens and Piney appears to be making a bid to return the mortar class of munitions to viability.  Rumors are flying that an upgrade program may be offered for the older mortars.

name: Shard
description: With this release, Cromforge shows that its laser research program is still producing results.

name: Flail
description: Dorator may be attempting to upstage Aristio with this weapon, which some claim to merely be a reverse-engineered Hitman with some minor improvements.

name: Prospector
description: During the development of the Heavy Miner class of vessels, Venurian Prospecting was brought into design talks early in order to guarantee that effective lasers would be available for these ships.

name: Financier Mk.II
description: During the development of the Heavy Miner class of vessels, Venurian Prospecting was brought into design talks early in order to guarantee that effective lasers would be available for these ships.

name: Spitfire
description: Aristio's entry into the ion weapons field challenges Annihilitech's monopoly.  Regardless of business concerns, this more lightweight device promises to make ion guns very popular, especially among Quantar pilots.
